stem: An object falls from a bridge that is 45 m above the water. It falls directly into a small row-boat moving with constant velocity that was 12 m from the point of impact when the object was released. What was the speed of the boat?

assets.alt: A stone dropped from a bridge 45 m above the water falls straight down (red dashed arrow). A boat moving right at speed v_b is 12 m short of the drop point at the moment of release and reaches it as the stone hits the water.
